questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Lesotho?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter M and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Lesotho article.

questions.proof: The capital of Lesotho is Maseru.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Lesotho?

hints.nudge: It is 2 words long and starts with the letter S.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Lesotho article.

questions.proof: Lesotho's position is unusual: it is completely surrounded by South Africa and has no borders with any other country.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Lesotho became a country in _____, but it was then called Basutoland.”
